fields.options: Controls whether backdated and forward-dated postings are allowed on Payment Vouchers, Receipt Vouchers, Ex Student Receipts, Journal Entries, Purchase Orders, Purchase Receipts and Purchase Invoices — site-wide, across all companies. The master switch below disables enforcement entirely without losing your rules.

fields.description: Master switch. When unchecked, no posting-date checks run on any document. Use this to temporarily relax the policy without losing your rule rows.
fields.label: Enforce Posting-Date Restrictions

fields.description: When checked, the policy also runs on amendments of previously-submitted documents. Uncheck if amendments need to bypass the rule for back-office corrections.
fields.label: Apply Policy to Amendments

fields.description: Users holding any of these roles bypass the policy entirely on every controlled DocType. Leave empty for no bypass.
fields.label: Roles That Bypass This Policy

fields.description: One rule per controlled DocType. The seven default rows are seeded automatically; you only need to flip the relevant flags and set the day caps.
fields.label: Rules
